aiResearch.cloudRetention: Vision sends only the payload shown below. The recoverable investigation remains local until you delete it; disclosure history stores metadata, not the exact outbound payload. OpenAI store:false does not by itself promise zero provider retention, a particular training or advertising policy, or no onward processing.
aiResearch.cloudSynthesisWarning: Warning: OpenAI writes the final answer from the exact evidence shown in the preview. That evidence may contain private financial data. Vision sends no database connection, other records, local documents, tools, or conversation history. The recoverable investigation keeps this evidence locally until you delete it; disclosure history keeps metadata only. The grant is short-lived and bounded, and store:false is not a zero-retention guarantee.
aiResearch.detailedProfile: Detailed. Capability: more evidence and a larger answer budget; local mode may add one local planning pass. Privacy: it does not add permitted fields or bypass the displayed cloud preview.
aiResearch.failed: The investigation could not be started.
aiResearch.modeCloudPublicProfile: OpenAI public planning. Capability: OpenAI orders bounded step identifiers; Vision retrieves evidence and writes the final answer locally. Cloud data: the separate public question, schema, language, depth, and coarse step identifiers. Privacy: no private question, records, values, passages, or final answer. Local retention: recoverable job until deletion; disclosure metadata separately deletable.
aiResearch.modeCloudSynthesisProfile: OpenAI selected-evidence synthesis. Capability: OpenAI writes the final answer without tools. Cloud data: the exact selected evidence, answer schema, language, and depth shown in the preview. Privacy: selected evidence may be private; no database access, automatic record retrieval, hidden context, or local fallback. Local retention: the recoverable job contains the evidence until deletion; disclosure history contains metadata only.
aiResearch.modeLocalProfile: Local model. Capability: local planning, evidence retrieval, and final synthesis. Model-cloud data: none. Privacy: public research still contacts external providers only when separately enabled below. Local retention: recoverable job until deletion.
aiResearch.modeSelectedSummaryProfile: OpenAI selected-summary planning. Capability: OpenAI orders bounded step identifiers using only the summary; Vision retrieves evidence and writes the final answer locally. Cloud data: the exact selected summary, schema, language, depth, and coarse step identifiers. Privacy: no other local records or passages. Local retention: recoverable job until deletion; disclosure metadata separately deletable.

tax.rules.investment.foreign: Foreign dividends/interest: declare yearly, treaty credit may apply
tax.rules.investment.savings: Belgian savings interest: first EUR 1,050 exempt, then 15% withholding tax

tax.subjectToReynders.desc: Direct bond gains are exempt pre-2026; from IY 2026 they fall under the 10% CGT. Bond / mixed-bond funds pay 30% on the interest portion (remainder routed to CGT in 2026).
tax.suggestions.alimony.applied: Alimony is treated as an 80% deductible item from taxable base; estimated tax saving shown using your marginal rate (illustrative).
tax.suggestions.childcare.noAmount: You marked childcare eligible but did not enter costs. The credit is 45% up to €16.90 per day (2025) per eligible child. Enter eligible days for a tighter cap.
tax.suggestions.childcare.notMarked: You entered childcare costs but did not mark them eligible. Mark to apply the 45% federal credit up to the daily cap.
tax.suggestions.childcare.suggest: You have dependents; childcare costs may qualify for a 45% credit. Example used: {days} eligible days.
tax.suggestions.domestic.noAmount: You marked domestic help eligible but did not enter costs. PwC: 30% credit when eligible (caps and conditions vary).
tax.suggestions.domestic.notMarked: You entered domestic help costs but did not mark them eligible. Mark to apply the 30% credit.
tax.suggestions.donations.noAmount: You marked charitable donations eligible but did not enter an amount. PwC: 45% reduction for qualifying donations (minimum €40 to recognized EEA institutions).
tax.suggestions.donations.notMarked: You entered donations but did not mark them eligible. Mark as qualifying donations to apply the 45% reduction.
tax.suggestions.donations.note: 45% credit for qualifying donations ≥ €40 to recognized EEA institutions (PwC).
tax.suggestions.group.noAmount: You marked group insurance eligible but did not enter a contribution amount. Employee group insurance often qualifies for a federal credit.
tax.suggestions.group.notMarked: You entered group insurance contributions but did not mark them eligible. Mark to apply the federal credit (~30%).
tax.suggestions.group.suggest: If you are an employee, employee group insurance contributions may entitle you to a federal credit (30%).
tax.suggestions.life.noAmount: You marked life insurance as eligible but did not enter a premium amount. PwC cap: €2,530 @30%.
tax.suggestions.life.notMarked: You entered life insurance premiums but did not mark them eligible. Mark to apply the 30% federal credit (up to cap).
tax.suggestions.multipleResidencesNote: If you own multiple properties, the portfolio tax page shows estimated regional property taxes per residence; an aggregated estimate is included in the general tax totals as informational only.
tax.suggestions.none: No obvious missing deductions detected. Review regional items below or open your tax profile to confirm inputs.
tax.suggestions.pension.noAmount: You marked pension contributions as eligible but did not enter an amount. PwC: up to €1,050 @30% (standard) or €1,350 @25% (alternative).
tax.suggestions.pension.notMarked: You entered pension contributions but did not mark them eligible. Mark as eligible to apply the federal tax credit.
tax.suggestions.pension.suggest: Pension savings may provide a federal tax credit. Consider contributing (PwC ceilings apply).
